description: The other direction: given a product from get_products, which suppliers carry its items and at what cost. Answers 'who can I reorder this from', 'who is cheapest for this', 'am I buying this from more than one place'. Nothing comes back when the product is linked to no supplier — that is a real answer, not an error: it cannot be purchase-ordered until it is linked.
name: hub_get_suppliers_for_product
title: Who supplies a product
